description: #486: an H10 chain -- five H2 on z, bond 1.4 bohr, 4.0 bohr between molecules -- in cc-pVDZ, Cartesian, with PySCF's converged RHF density recorded: the first fixture whose density decays with distance (#484's per-block density factor can fire on it). Records the converted basis and PySCF's get_jk J for the recorded density. -- the basis and the one-electron arrays only, copied by tools/extract_integral_golden.py

provenance.command: PYTHONPATH=test uv run --group oracle python -m oracle.generate --regenerate h10_chain_ccpvdz_j
